properties.name: Sri Aurobindo Marg CAAQMS
properties.claim: DPCC continuous monitor; ~AQI 137 in cleaner spells, but 399-657 (severe) in peak winter (Dec 2025). Live feed = AQICN station A567721.

properties.name: Lodhi Road CAAQMS

properties.name: R.K. Puram CAAQMS
properties.claim: DPCC continuous monitor (CPCB station 25 of the Delhi-NCR CAAQMS network) in the R.K. Puram assembly segment -- a distinct station from Sri Aurobindo Marg, not a duplicate of it.
properties._note: exact station address/coordinates weren't published on the sources checked (AQICN page, CPCB station list PDFs) -- placed at the R.K. Puram AC centroid as an honest placeholder pending a precise address.
